content: KAYAK OUḎI NEUM
Aria Juda dilag deḏ oḵai laa onig Pentikos, deḏ amu uḏie amu ag oh uḏin, aben laip̱u ap̱a qag mep̱ig.
Qag men daaegeg, hab aṯannu oqoṯi paha laip̱un uḏiom. Oqoṯi amu ulah naḏi g̱agaṯag uḏiaya, oqoṯi oṯe bia. Uḏie, ag daap̱ig ele amu, ag lag amu oo ohp̱a oqoṯi huana doop̱ig.
Ag keeke amu doyeg amu ab ewawa, lemaḏmaḏ qeṯe amubia haaha, pane ne, danab daap̱ig amu oh anen anen dilagp̱a paniom anidp̱ig.
Anam he amu danab oolagp̱a genab doop̱ig ele, danab amu ag oh Kayak Ouḏi ag oolagp̱a am be, ag ahan, nai diigdiigp̱a nai madip̱ig. Amu Kayak Ouḏi Nug he, ag oḏelagp̱a anam nai madip̱ig.
Haen amup̱a wan ohp̱anu Juda danab, ag Kayak dab medap̱ig ele amu, ag gona ab ab daap̱ig, ap̱anu uḏin Jerusalem daap̱ig.
Ag haen amu oqoṯi amu doona, danab ah ameg naḏi uḏin qag mena, danab piḏe piḏenu ag oh totol danab, ag ahilag naip̱a nai mehuqegeg doop̱ig.
Ag nailagp̱a nai mehuqeg doonna, ag oṯaina, ag dab mak kuḏum aona ap̱ig. “Umu aḏi? Aṯem hena heṯeb? Danab nai madiṯeb ele umu ag amu Galelia danab.
Amu aṯemun ig oh danab ab laalap̱anu amu ig nainigp̱a nai dooṯem? Ig aninḵad mamenḵad maṯiegeg dooṯem amubia dooṯem.
Ig amu Patia, Midia, Ilam, amu Mesopotemia ele daaṯem. Amu Juda, Kapadosia, Pontus Asia ele daaṯem.
Amu Prisia, Pampilia, Igipta amu laih Libianu, Sairini guguiṯaknu ele daaṯem. Amu Rom danab ele ig oh uḏimut daaṯem.
Ig Juda amu laala Juda kobol awak ele, amu ig Krit amu Arabia ap̱anu ele uḏimut. Uḏit, ig oh nainig aben abenp̱a Kayak uḏat enanag heumnu mehuqegeg dooṯem,” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam anana, ag oh eheḏ oṯaina, dab mak kuḏum aona, ag aḵa aḵa, “Keeke umu amu aṯemunnab?” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam ap̱ig amge laala ag awa awa qeṯak nai maṯin, inam ap̱ig. “Umu amu ag wain huana laeg, kaaka aqe heṯeb,” aon ap̱ig.
PETRUS NAI MEHUQOM

Ag anam aon aeg amu Petrus aha hibaiṯe, totol danab elewen amu ele ahaeg, nug g̱agaṯag ewa, danab ah ag tutuḵu doona maidḵulagnu inam aum. “Juda danab ag amu danab uḏip̱ig gemu Jerusalem daaṯeb ele ag oh, da nai madip̱i, ag daulag human dab mebep̱eg, da keeke amunu diig mehuqp̱i doyeg!
Ag, ‘Danab imu wain laegeg, kaaka aqaṯe,’ aṯeb amge danab imu ag anam ii heṯeb. Iiṯa! Geha iiḵu am buṯua 9 kilokib amu ag dooṯeb, ig buṯuanab wain ii laṯem.
Kobol imu am kaaka aqaknu iiṯa. Kobol imu amu anuḵa propet Joel nug Kayak oḏe awa, nai maṯiom amu, nug maṯiomnu iiḵu beṯe.

Kayak Nug inam Joel amegp̱a a doya yom. ‘Dimp̱a haen nug malaḵunu heebeb, haen gamag amup̱a da dahil Ouḏi, danab ah madaḵul. Madap̱i amu ag Kayak Ouḏi aop̱ig ele, ag oolagp̱anu amu laala geha ag propet dahil nai mehuqḵulag. Amu geha da laala keeke diigdiig tuleglegp̱a ip̱uanadḵul am laala ag amu doyak tul niiakp̱a madaḵul.
Amu geha haen amup̱a da uḏat nid, uḏat ah dahilad ele Ouḏi dahil madap̱i, ag dahil nai mehuqḵulag.
Da geha kobol diig laa habp̱a hep̱i, aam nug gatatu manebeb, kalam am tiig eḏuḵu. Aria wanp̱a da ep̱onak keeke, tiig, ab aḏu amu kahug naḏi ele hep̱i, geha beḵulag. Amu Naḏinu deḏ am geha dim beḵu.
Amu danab ah oh ag Naḏi eḏua diiḵunu eḵulag amu, ag ehaniṯak amu aoglag.’ Joel anam yom.

Amu Israel danab ag nai imu doyeg! Da ag amelagp̱a Jesus, Nasaret ted, nuhignu ap̱i dooglag. Ag aḵa aaḵu dooṯeb, Kayak Nug ehaniṯe, Nug ag oolagp̱a ep̱onak keeke, danab heḵunu elele iiṯa diigdiig heum. Kayak he, Jesus anam heum, amuam Kayak Nug Jesus me neum ip̱uanadṯe.
Kayak Nug anuḵa nuhig doyakp̱a anam heḵunu nai maṯiom amu Nug Jesus awa, ag ep̱elagp̱a me, ag danab nau, ahilag ehaniṯakp̱a, ad emaitakp̱a atulna qeeg mauhom.
Amge Kayak Nug mauhak oolagp̱anu uhuqa he, eḏua hibaiṯom. Mauhak amu Nug aḏaḵunu elele iiṯa.
Amuam Dawit nuhignu yom amubia. Dawit nug inam yom. ‘Naḏi Nug ou iwa daaṯe anidṯem. Nug da ele ou qeḏa, g̱agaṯag meḏeḏe amunu keeke laa nug da ii uḏaliḏma.
Amunu da oo maḏoḏ enanag ele dayeye, oo gamag ahak nai maṯieye, da daḵa dimp̱a keeke ena aoḵul amunu ameg meṯem.
Aḏinu? Na geha da ii uuiḏmana amunu da mauhak daaṯeb abenp̱a ii daapa. Am geha na nahip danab tutuḵu op̱ia awak ele amu, na ii uuidmana amunu mauhak nug heeb, beḏu ii nauhma.
Na bau dayaknu ib da ip̱uniḏme. Na da ele daagnih amunu da oo gamag ahak oḵainab dooḵul,’ awa yom.” Petrus nug anam awa aum.

Nug anam anana, nug nai baula tuḏiṯa aum. “O lailad, Dawit nug nai amu maṯiom amu nug nuhignu dab maama ii maṯiom. Ig amu aṯem doognig am Dawit nug mauhe boomeg, nuhig boomak aben ig oonigp̱a iiḵu daaṯe.

Dawit nug propet dayom amu Kayak Nug nuḵa nuhig nai g̱agaṯag qedaṯa, Dawit amegp̱a inam a doyom. ‘Dimp̱a na buḏunp̱an da king laa otip̱i ba, nahip king uḏat amu Nug heḵu,’ awa aum. Nug anam a, Dawit doyom amge
amu ii nak haenp̱a nug dimp̱a Kayak Nug heeb, Kristus Nug mauhakp̱anu eḏua hip̱aidḵu, mauhak abenp̱a ii daama, Nug beḏu ele ii beḏamanu aum.
Aria anam amunu ag doyeg! Kayak Nug he, Jesus eḏua hibaiṯom. Ig oh Nug anam heum amu anidmut amunu ig iiḵu madiṯem.

Nug hab aṯan teum, Kayak ep̱eg naḏiapp̱a, amuam anuqak aben, amup̱a daaṯe. Mameg Kayak Nug nuhig Ouḏi, anuḵa medaḵunu nai qaḵa aum bia amu, Nug meṯom. Meṯe, Jesus Nug ig ele iiḵu gemu Kayak Ouḏi meḵom amunu ag keeke imu gemu anidna dooṯeb,” awa aum.

Amu Petrus nug anam anana, nug nai imu tuḏiṯa amelagp̱a aum. “Dawit nug nai laa ele aum am inam. ‘Naḏi Nug Naḏi dahil amegp̱a inam aum. Na am dahil dayaknu aben anuqak imup̱a daap̱e uḵeb, dimp̱a da geha kekeḏ nahipad oh tap̱aladp̱i, ag na waatp̱a daaglag,’ awa aum. Aria Dawit nai amu maṯiom haenp̱a nug nuḵa nuhignu dab maama ii maṯiom. Iiṯa. Nug mauhe, beḏu hab aṯan ii teum. Iiṯa. Ag nug boomp̱ig amunu nug nai amup̱a Jesus ip̱uniḵa heum.
Amunu Israel beḵod, ag oh tutuḵunab doyeg! Kayak Nug he, Jesus Nug Naḏi, am Kristus ele daaṯe. Ag Nug ad emaitakp̱a atulp̱ig.” Petrus amelagp̱a anam maṯie doop̱ig.
Ag nai maṯie doona, nai amu ag oolagnab yom amunu ag ahan, Petrus amu totol danab elewen ele ag amelagp̱a inam ap̱ig. “O ig lainḵad, geha ig aṯemtai heḵunig?” aon ap̱ig.

Aon aeg am Petrus nug amelagp̱a aum. “Kayak Nug ahilag hip̱unin uhuqa madaḵunu amu ag oh aḵa anen anen ag oolag eḏueb, Jesus Kristus onigp̱a layaṯak aweg! Ag anam hep̱eg, Kayak Nug nuhig Ouḏi ag hamu madaḵu.

Am Kayak Nug anuḵa Nuhig Ouḏi ag amu ag beḵalḵad amu wan laa adep̱a danab ah daaṯeb ag ele madaḵunu nai qaḵa aum. Yo aun aḏi ag ihinig Naḏi Kayak Nug ag onilagp̱a eḵu amu, ag madaḵunu nai qaḵa aum,” awa aum.

Am Petrus nug nai kuḏum laala ele dab mak awaknu nai mehuqaqa, nug amelagp̱a inam aum. “Ag lailḵad ag Jesusnu oolagp̱a genab ii dooṯeb amubia ag aib hep̱ig. Iiṯa! Ag oolag eḏueb, Kayaknu ehaniṯak aweg!” awa aum.
KRISTEN BAU AMU AHILAG HAK ENA
Am danab Petrus nai maṯiom amu genab doonna, ahilag eb qak 3000 keeke amu ag layaṯak aop̱ig. Aona ag Jesusnu oolagp̱a genab doop̱ig ele amu oolagp̱a uḵaeg, oh laip̱u daanna
amu ag totol danab tuelp nai mehuqegeg doonna, laip̱u dayak ena daanna, nug ehanidnana, e laip̱u lanan, Kayak unuqidp̱ig.
Ag anam henana, danab ah oh ag Kayaknu enanag doona, ag oolag ele oṯaiom. Amu Kayak Nug totol danab tuelp ep̱elagp̱a ep̱onak keeke, danab heḵunu elele iiṯa amu kuḏum diigdiig ele heum.

Anam heehe, danab oh ag Kristusnu oolagp̱a genab doop̱ig ele amu, ag oolag laip̱u mena, laip̱u qag mak daanna, danab laala ag keeke ele amu aḵa ahilagnuib ii aḏap̱ig. Iiṯa, ag laip̱u qag mak daaṯeb ag oh ahilag dayom.
Am danab laala ag wan ele amu laala ag keeke ele amu ag heeg, danab laa daden meeg, ag men doḏo amu aona, danab laala e aon laḵulagnu elele iiṯa daap̱ig amu otin madap̱ig.

Ag anam henan, ag oh oolag laip̱u daanna amu deḏ oh mana meṯak laḵa gonana, Kayak nai doop̱ig. Amge ag laulag anen anen oh oina, ag oo gamag ahak doonna, ag Kayak amegp̱a, “Ena hen meḵame,” anana, e lap̱ig.

Anam henana, haen oh Kayak binag meegeg, danab ah laala oh ahilagnu oolag enaib dayom. Haen amu deḏ ohp̱a Kayak Nug danab ah laala eḏua diieye, ag kristen tamaniak oop̱a daap̱ig ele amu, ag ele tuḏidp̱ig.
